_comment: Illustrative. Not a real patient. One coherent twelve-month story, authored by hand. counterLine is derived from the data above it by content/_build_compounding.py, so the counts can never drift from the table. Have a nurse read this before it goes live.

carriedQuestion.text: Hand swelling. Has this been mentioned to anyone?
carriedQuestion.resolution: Raised at nephrology, 14 Sept. Referred to rheumatology.

visits.note: Baseline. Two standing medicines recorded for the first time.
visits.counterLine: Visit 1. One specialist. Two medicines recorded.

visits.note: Swelling in the right hand raised by the companion. Doctor advised watching it. No test ordered.
questionsRaised: Hand swelling. Has this been mentioned to anyone?
visits.counterLine: Visit 2. One specialist. Two medicines recorded. One question raised, and unanswered.

visits.note: Renal panel read in the room. eGFR 58. Telmisartan started.
visits.counterLine: Visit 3. Two specialists. Three medicines recorded. One question carried across one month, still unanswered.

visits.note: HbA1c 7.6%. Glimepiride added, dose held low because of the May renal result.
visits.counterLine: Visit 4. Two specialists. Four medicines recorded. One question carried across two months, still unanswered.

visits.note: Oral anti-inflammatory proposed for knee pain. Companion produced the May eGFR. Withdrawn, topical substituted.
visits.counterLine: Visit 5. Three specialists. Six medicines recorded. One withdrawn. One question carried across three months, still unanswered.

visits.note: Swelling raised again with the renal panel in hand. Referred to rheumatology. Amlodipine added for blood pressure.
questionsResolved: Raised at nephrology, 14 Sept. Referred to rheumatology.
visits.counterLine: Visit 6. Three specialists. Seven medicines recorded. One withdrawn. The question from April answered, after five months.
Visit 7. Four specialists. Eight medicines recorded. One withdrawn.

visits.note: Review. Calcium with vitamin D3 added.
visits.counterLine: Visit 8. Four specialists. Nine medicines recorded. One withdrawn.

visits.note: Two low-sugar episodes reported by the family. Glimepiride withdrawn.
visits.counterLine: Visit 9. Four specialists. Nine medicines recorded. Two withdrawn.

visits.note: Diabetic eye screening. Raised eye pressure found. Latanoprost started.
visits.counterLine: Visit 10. Five specialists. Ten medicines recorded. Two withdrawn.

visits.note: eGFR down to 44. Metformin reduced from 1000mg to 500mg twice daily.
visits.counterLine: Visit 11. Five specialists. Ten medicines recorded. Two withdrawn.

visits.note: Annual review. No change. The full year is on one page for the first time.
visits.counterLine: Visit 12. Five specialists. Ten medicines recorded. Two withdrawn.
